# `aitbc exchange status`

Get the status and configuration of a specific registered exchange.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--exchange-name` | text | — | yes | The Exchange name. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange status --exchange-name <exchange_name>
```
